enchant.ne.neko_blade.desc: The lower the durability of the weapon the higher the damage increase, up to 1.15x.
enchant.ne.neko_god.desc: Very low probability of dealing command level damage, probability affected by luck.
enchant.ne.neko_meow.desc: The attack itself makes a catcall. Nothing more.
enchant.ne.neko_king.desc: You can use minerals to strengthen your weapon, adding 1 point of damage for every 20 points of strengthening.
enchant.ne.neko_emperor.desc: The number of kills will be recorded, and for every 50 kills, 1 point of damage will be added.
enchant.ne.neko_day.desc: Increases damage during the day and decreases it at night.
enchant.ne.neko_night.desc: Increases damage at night and decreases it during the day.
enchant.ne.neko_ninja.desc: Goes into stealth when taking damage and increases damage.
enchant.ne.neko_soul.desc: Gain souls per attack, and spend 200 souls to heal 10% of your life when wounded.
enchant.ne.neko_blessing.desc: Gain one tier of blessing per cat bred, reducing by two tiers when the cat dies. Consume one tier of blessing to reduce damage when injured, stackable.
enchant.ne.neko_mirror.desc: Has a chance to bounce back damage when injured and is immune to this damage.
enchant.ne.neko_life.desc: Has a probability to mitigate damage greater than 20% of life and less than 150% to 20%.
enchant.ne.neko_chop.desc: There is a probability of obtaining a biological head
enchant.ne.z_confusion.desc: Attacked creatures treat other creatures nearest to the player as targets
enchant.ne.zi_bright.desc: Monsters avoid it when holding it.
enchant.ne.zi_alone.desc: Only this enchantment provides a damage bonus that varies with the number of times it is used.
enchant.ne.zi_indestructible.desc: Prevent destruction when in a dropped state.
enchant.ne.zi_unbreakable.desc: Use NETHERITE BLOCK at the Anvil to strengthen it five times to unlock it.
enchant.ne.tori_no_uta.desc: When there is a feather in the offhand,Increase arrow speed
enchant.ne.chain_harvesting.desc: Collect all identical squares within range
enchant.ne.curse_disease.desc: Gain random negative effects when attacking
enchant.ne.corrode.desc: Attacks have a chance to lose half of their current durability
item.ne.revelation_stone.tooltip: Right click to reveal an enhancement
